@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+name: Build and release UDB gem dependencies to GitHub
+
+# Builds and uploads prebuilt espresso and/or must binaries as GitHub release assets.
+# Run this workflow manually whenever a tool version needs to be updated.
+#
+# Steps:
+#   1. Create a GitHub release tag (e.g. espresso-1.0 or must-17fa9f9) on the repo.
+#   2. Trigger this workflow via workflow_dispatch, selecting the tool and tag.
+#   3. The workflow builds on native amd64 and arm64 runners and uploads the binaries.
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      tool:
+        description: "Tool to build"
+        required: true
+        type: choice
+        options:
+          - espresso
+          - must
+          - z3
+          - all
+      tag:
+        description: "Release tag to upload assets to (e.g. espresso-1.0 or must-17fa9f9)"
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+jobs:
+  build-z3:
+    if: inputs.tool == 'z3' || inputs.tool == 'all'
+    name: Build Z3 (${{ matrix.arch }})
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        include:
+          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
+            arch: x64
+          - runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+            arch: arm64
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+
+      - name: Install GitHub CLI
+        run: |
+          type -p curl >/dev/null || (sudo apt update && sudo apt install curl -y)
+          curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg | sudo dd of=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
+          sudo chmod go+r /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
+          echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list > /dev/null
+          sudo apt update
+          sudo apt install gh -y
+
+      - name: Authenticate GitHub CLI
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+        run: |
+          echo "$GH_TOKEN" | gh auth login --with-token
+
+      - name: Build and upload Z3 for ${{ matrix.arch }}
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+        run: |
+          ./bin/chore update z3 -n
+
+  build-espresso:
+    if: inputs.tool == 'espresso' || inputs.tool == 'all'
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        include:
+          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
+            arch: x64
+          - runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+            arch: arm64
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+
+      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
+        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@8d2750c68a42422c14e847fe6c8ac0403b4cbd6f # v3.12.0
+
+      - name: Build espresso (${{ matrix.arch }})
+        run: bash tools/scripts/build_espresso_with_docker.sh ./espresso-out ${{ matrix.arch }}
+
+      - name: Rename binary with arch suffix
+        run: mv ./espresso-out/espresso ./espresso-${{ matrix.arch }}
+
+      - name: Upload espresso-${{ matrix.arch }} to release
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+        run: |
+          gh release upload "${{ inputs.tag }}" \
+            "espresso-${{ matrix.arch }}" \
+            --clobber
+
+  build-must:
+    if: inputs.tool == 'must' || inputs.tool == 'all'
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        include:
+          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
+            arch: x64
+          - runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+            arch: arm64
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+
+      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
+        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@8d2750c68a42422c14e847fe6c8ac0403b4cbd6f # v3.12.0
+
+      - name: Build must (${{ matrix.arch }})
+        run: bash tools/scripts/build_must_with_docker.sh ./must-out ${{ matrix.arch }}
+
+      - name: Rename binary with arch suffix
+        run: mv ./must-out/must ./must-${{ matrix.arch }}
+
+      - name: Upload must-${{ matrix.arch }} to release
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+        run: |
+          gh release upload "${{ inputs.tag }}" \
+            "must-${{ matrix.arch }}" \
+            --clobber

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Copyright (c) Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear
+
+# Build espresso from source using Docker and AlmaLinux 8.
+# Produces a statically-linked binary for maximum portability (glibc 2.28+).
+#
+# Usage: build_espresso_with_docker.sh [output_dir] [architecture]
+#   output_dir   - where to place the binary (default: ./espresso-build)
+#   architecture - x64 or arm64 (default: x64)
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+error() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
+info()  { echo "INFO: $*"  >&2; }
+
+command_exists() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
+
+build_espresso_with_docker() {
+    local output_dir="${1:-./espresso-build}"
+    local architecture="${2:-x64}"
+
+    case "${architecture,,}" in
+        x64|amd64|x86_64)
+            architecture="x64"
+            local docker_platform="linux/amd64"
+            ;;
+        arm64|aarch64)
+            architecture="arm64"
+            local docker_platform="linux/arm64"
+            ;;
+        *)
+            error "Invalid architecture: $architecture. Must be x64 or arm64"
+            ;;
+    esac
+
+    info "Building espresso"
+    info "Output directory: $output_dir"
+    info "Architecture: $architecture ($docker_platform)"
+
+    command_exists docker || error "Docker is not installed or not in PATH"
+
+    local temp_dir
+    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d -t espresso-build-XXXXXX)
+    trap "rm -rf '$temp_dir'" EXIT
+
+    info "Using temporary directory: $temp_dir"
+
+    # Write Dockerfile
+    cat > "$temp_dir/Dockerfile" << 'EOF'
+FROM almalinux:8
+
+RUN dnf install -y \
+    gcc-toolset-14 \
+    make \
+    glibc-static \
+    && dnf clean all
+
+ENV PATH=/opt/rh/gcc-toolset-14/root/usr/bin:$PATH \
+    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rh/gcc-toolset-14/root/usr/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
+
+WORKDIR /build
+
+# Clone espresso source
+RUN git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/psksvp/espresso-ab-1.0.git espresso
+
+WORKDIR /build/espresso
+
+# Configure and build with static linking
+RUN ./configure LDFLAGS="-static" && \
+    make -j$(nproc) && \
+    strip espresso
+
+RUN touch /build/BUILD_SUCCESS
+EOF
+
+    local image_name="espresso-builder-$$"
+    info "Building Docker image for $docker_platform..."
+    docker build --platform="$docker_platform" -t "$image_name" -f "$temp_dir/Dockerfile" "$temp_dir" \
+        || error "Docker build failed"
+
+    local container_name="espresso-extract-$$"
+    docker create --name "$container_name" "$image_name" || error "Failed to create container"
+
+    if ! docker cp "$container_name:/build/BUILD_SUCCESS" "$temp_dir/" 2>/dev/null; then
+        docker rm "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        docker rmi "$image_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        error "espresso build failed - BUILD_SUCCESS marker not found"
+    fi
+
+    mkdir -p "$output_dir"
+    docker cp "$container_name:/build/espresso/espresso" "$output_dir/espresso" \
+        || error "Failed to extract espresso binary"
+    chmod +x "$output_dir/espresso"
+
+    docker rm "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    docker rmi "$image_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+
+    info "Build completed successfully!"
+    info "Binary: $output_dir/espresso"
+    ls -lh "$output_dir/espresso"
+}
+
+if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
+    if [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && [[ "$1" == "-h" || "$1" == "--help" ]]; then
+        echo "Usage: $0 [output_dir] [architecture]" >&2
+        echo "  output_dir   - where to place the binary (default: ./espresso-build)" >&2
+        echo "  architecture - x64 or arm64 (default: x64)" >&2
+        exit 0
+    fi
+    build_espresso_with_docker "${1:-./espresso-build}" "${2:-x64}"
+fi

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Copyright (c) Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause-Clear
+
+# Build must (mustool) from source using Docker and AlmaLinux 8.
+# Produces a statically-linked binary for maximum portability (glibc 2.28+).
+#
+# Usage: build_must_with_docker.sh [output_dir] [architecture]
+#   output_dir   - where to place the binary (default: ./must-build)
+#   architecture - x64 or arm64 (default: x64)
+#
+# The pinned commit matches MUST_VERSION in the udb gem.
+# To update: change MUST_COMMIT below and update lib/udb/MUST_VERSION accordingly.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+error() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
+info()  { echo "INFO: $*"  >&2; }
+
+command_exists() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
+
+# Pinned commit - must match lib/udb/MUST_VERSION
+MUST_COMMIT="17fa9f9542a9ce05328dfccd1cd410f05f741ab3"
+
+build_must_with_docker() {
+    local output_dir="${1:-./must-build}"
+    local architecture="${2:-x64}"
+
+    case "${architecture,,}" in
+        x64|amd64|x86_64)
+            architecture="x64"
+            local docker_platform="linux/amd64"
+            ;;
+        arm64|aarch64)
+            architecture="arm64"
+            local docker_platform="linux/arm64"
+            ;;
+        *)
+            error "Invalid architecture: $architecture. Must be x64 or arm64"
+            ;;
+    esac
+
+    info "Building must (mustool @ $MUST_COMMIT)"
+    info "Output directory: $output_dir"
+    info "Architecture: $architecture ($docker_platform)"
+
+    command_exists docker || error "Docker is not installed or not in PATH"
+
+    local temp_dir
+    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d -t must-build-XXXXXX)
+    trap "rm -rf '$temp_dir'" EXIT
+
+    info "Using temporary directory: $temp_dir"
+
+    # Write Dockerfile - MUST_COMMIT is baked in at image-build time via ARG
+    cat > "$temp_dir/Dockerfile" << 'EOF'
+FROM almalinux:8
+
+RUN dnf install -y \
+    gcc-toolset-14 \
+    make \
+    git \
+    zlib-static \
+    glibc-static \
+    libstdc++-static \
+    && dnf clean all
+
+ENV PATH=/opt/rh/gcc-toolset-14/root/usr/bin:$PATH \
+    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rh/gcc-toolset-14/root/usr/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
+
+ARG MUST_COMMIT
+WORKDIR /build
+
+RUN git clone https://github.com/jar-ben/mustool.git must && \
+    cd must && \
+    git checkout ${MUST_COMMIT}
+
+WORKDIR /build/must
+
+# Apply the missing #include <cstdio> patch
+RUN sed -i -e 's/#include <signal.h>/#include <signal.h>\n#include <cstdio>/' \
+    mcsmus/mcsmus/control.cc
+
+# Build; link statically where possible
+RUN make -j$(nproc) LDFLAGS="-static" && \
+    strip must
+
+RUN touch /build/BUILD_SUCCESS
+EOF
+
+    local image_name="must-builder-$$"
+    info "Building Docker image for $docker_platform..."
+    docker build \
+        --platform="$docker_platform" \
+        --build-arg "MUST_COMMIT=$MUST_COMMIT" \
+        -t "$image_name" \
+        -f "$temp_dir/Dockerfile" \
+        "$temp_dir" \
+        || error "Docker build failed"
+
+    local container_name="must-extract-$$"
+    docker create --name "$container_name" "$image_name" || error "Failed to create container"
+
+    if ! docker cp "$container_name:/build/BUILD_SUCCESS" "$temp_dir/" 2>/dev/null; then
+        docker rm "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        docker rmi "$image_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        error "must build failed - BUILD_SUCCESS marker not found"
+    fi
+
+    mkdir -p "$output_dir"
+    docker cp "$container_name:/build/must/must" "$output_dir/must" \
+        || error "Failed to extract must binary"
+    chmod +x "$output_dir/must"
+
+    docker rm "$container_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    docker rmi "$image_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+
+    info "Build completed successfully!"
+    info "Binary: $output_dir/must"
+    ls -lh "$output_dir/must"
+}
+
+if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
+    if [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && [[ "$1" == "-h" || "$1" == "--help" ]]; then
+        echo "Usage: $0 [output_dir] [architecture]" >&2
+        echo "  output_dir   - where to place the binary (default: ./must-build)" >&2
+        echo "  architecture - x64 or arm64 (default: x64)" >&2
+        exit 0
+    fi
+    build_must_with_docker "${1:-./must-build}" "${2:-x64}"
+fi
